title: La Mora - opening bass staff
source_location: York University John Arpin collection JAC009399, printed and PDF p. 2, systems 1–2.
scope: Lower piano staff for the one-bar introduction and repeated first strain, with both numbered endings. Cut before the next strain.
editorial: The introduction occupies one full 2/4 bar. The seven common bars are played twice, with the first and second endings taken in order. The alternate second ending on p. 3 is outside this excerpt.
System 2, common bar 6: the lower staff has five beamed attacks. The last two are realized as sixteenths, following the upper-staff alignment, which is clearer at the return on p. 4, system 2.

Second ending: the lower staff retains the nominal two eighth-note attacks, eighth rest and last eighth, even though the third octave is engraved under the first of the upper staff’s closing sixteenths.
Preview quarter-note tempo 96 and fixed velocity are editorial. Staccato and accent are not realized separately.
